idempotency.outcomeUnknownCheckList: We couldn’t confirm whether this was created — check the list before trying again.
idempotency.keyReusedRestoreOriginal: This differs from the request first sent for this action, which may already have gone through. Restore the original details to retry it, or check the list for its outcome.
idempotency.processingCheckStatus: This payment is still processing. Check its status before sending it again; sending the same details now returns this payment.
idempotency.keyNotPersisted: This browser isn’t keeping the request’s retry key (private browsing or storage full), so it wasn’t sent. Allow site storage and try again.
